question: How many customers are there?
sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Customer

question: How many tracks are longer than 5 minutes?
sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Track WHERE Milliseconds > 300000

question: List the names of all music genres.
sql: SELECT Name FROM Genre

question: Which countries do our customers come from?
sql: SELECT DISTINCT Country FROM Customer

question: What is the total revenue of all invoices?
sql: SELECT ROUND(SUM(Total), 2) FROM Invoice

question: How many employees work as Sales Support Agent?
sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Employee WHERE Title = 'Sales Support Agent'

question: What is the average price of a track?
sql: SELECT ROUND(AVG(UnitPrice), 2) FROM Track

question: How many customers live in Brazil?
sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Customer WHERE Country = 'Brazil'

question: Top 5 countries by total revenue.
sql: SELECT BillingCountry, ROUND(SUM(Total), 2) AS revenue FROM Invoice GROUP BY BillingCountry ORDER BY revenue DESC LIMIT 5

question: How many tracks are there in each genre? Show the 10 largest genres.
sql: SELECT g.Name, COUNT(*) AS n FROM Track t JOIN Genre g ON g.GenreId = t.GenreId GROUP BY g.Name ORDER BY n DESC LIMIT 10

question: Which artist has the most albums?
sql: SELECT ar.Name, COUNT(*) AS n FROM Album al JOIN Artist ar ON ar.ArtistId = al.ArtistId GROUP BY ar.ArtistId ORDER BY n DESC LIMIT 1

question: Total revenue per year.
sql: SELECT strftime('%Y', InvoiceDate) AS year, ROUND(SUM(Total), 2) FROM Invoice GROUP BY year ORDER BY year

question: Number of invoices per billing country, for countries with more than 20 invoices.
sql: SELECT BillingCountry, COUNT(*) AS n FROM Invoice GROUP BY BillingCountry HAVING n > 20

question: Average track length in minutes for each media type.
sql: SELECT m.Name, ROUND(AVG(t.Milliseconds) / 60000.0, 2) FROM Track t JOIN MediaType m ON m.MediaTypeId = t.MediaTypeId GROUP BY m.Name

question: Which 5 customers spent the most? Give their full name and total.
sql: SELECT c.FirstName || ' ' || c.LastName AS customer, ROUND(SUM(i.Total), 2) AS spent FROM Customer c JOIN Invoice i ON i.CustomerId = c.CustomerId GROUP BY c.CustomerId ORDER BY spent DESC LIMIT 5

question: How many tracks does each playlist contain? Show the 5 biggest playlists.
sql: SELECT p.PlaylistId, p.Name, COUNT(*) AS n FROM PlaylistTrack pt JOIN Playlist p ON p.PlaylistId = pt.PlaylistId GROUP BY p.PlaylistId ORDER BY n DESC LIMIT 5

question: Which albums by AC/DC are in the catalogue?
sql: SELECT al.Title FROM Album al JOIN Artist ar ON ar.ArtistId = al.ArtistId WHERE ar.Name = 'AC/DC'

question: Monthly revenue in 2013.
sql: SELECT strftime('%Y-%m', InvoiceDate) AS month, ROUND(SUM(Total), 2) FROM Invoice WHERE strftime('%Y', InvoiceDate) = '2013' GROUP BY month ORDER BY month

question: Top 5 genres by revenue.
sql: SELECT g.Name, ROUND(SUM(il.UnitPrice * il.Quantity), 2) AS revenue FROM InvoiceLine il JOIN Track t ON t.TrackId = il.TrackId JOIN Genre g ON g.GenreId = t.GenreId GROUP BY g.Name ORDER BY revenue DESC LIMIT 5

question: Total sales handled by each sales support agent.
sql: SELECT e.FirstName || ' ' || e.LastName AS agent, ROUND(SUM(i.Total), 2) FROM Employee e JOIN Customer c ON c.SupportRepId = e.EmployeeId JOIN Invoice i ON i.CustomerId = c.CustomerId GROUP BY e.EmployeeId

question: Top 5 best-selling artists by number of tracks sold.
sql: SELECT ar.Name, SUM(il.Quantity) AS sold FROM InvoiceLine il JOIN Track t ON t.TrackId = il.TrackId JOIN Album al ON al.AlbumId = t.AlbumId JOIN Artist ar ON ar.ArtistId = al.ArtistId GROUP BY ar.ArtistId ORDER BY sold DESC LIMIT 5

question: How many tracks have never been sold?
sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Track WHERE TrackId NOT IN (SELECT TrackId FROM InvoiceLine)

question: Which employees manage other employees, and how many people report to each?
sql: SELECT m.FirstName || ' ' || m.LastName AS manager, COUNT(*) FROM Employee e JOIN Employee m ON e.ReportsTo = m.EmployeeId GROUP BY m.EmployeeId

question: Average invoice total per customer country, top 5.
sql: SELECT c.Country, ROUND(AVG(i.Total), 2) AS avg_total FROM Invoice i JOIN Customer c ON c.CustomerId = i.CustomerId GROUP BY c.Country ORDER BY avg_total DESC LIMIT 5

question: Customers who bought at least one Jazz track: how many are there?
sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT i.CustomerId) FROM Invoice i JOIN InvoiceLine il ON il.InvoiceId = i.InvoiceId JOIN Track t ON t.TrackId = il.TrackId JOIN Genre g ON g.GenreId = t.GenreId WHERE g.Name = 'Jazz'

question: For each media type, the share of tracks sold in percent.
sql: SELECT m.Name, ROUND(100.0 * SUM(il.Quantity) / (SELECT SUM(Quantity) FROM InvoiceLine), 2) FROM InvoiceLine il JOIN Track t ON t.TrackId = il.TrackId JOIN MediaType m ON m.MediaTypeId = t.MediaTypeId GROUP BY m.Name

question: Which album has the longest total duration in minutes?
sql: SELECT al.Title, ROUND(SUM(t.Milliseconds) / 60000.0, 2) AS minutes FROM Track t JOIN Album al ON al.AlbumId = t.AlbumId GROUP BY al.AlbumId ORDER BY minutes DESC LIMIT 1

question: Number of distinct customers per year.
sql: SELECT strftime('%Y', InvoiceDate) AS year, COUNT(DISTINCT CustomerId) FROM Invoice GROUP BY year ORDER BY year

question: Top 3 composers by number of tracks, ignoring unknown composers.
sql: SELECT Composer, COUNT(*) AS n FROM Track WHERE Composer IS NOT NULL GROUP BY Composer ORDER BY n DESC LIMIT 3

question: Revenue per sales support agent per year.
sql: SELECT e.LastName, strftime('%Y', i.InvoiceDate) AS year, ROUND(SUM(i.Total), 2) FROM Employee e JOIN Customer c ON c.SupportRepId = e.EmployeeId JOIN Invoice i ON i.CustomerId = c.CustomerId GROUP BY e.EmployeeId, year ORDER BY e.LastName, year
